entries.64629d4d710b1e6d: The company is a publisher of educational books and a manufacturer and seller of teaching materials and teaching aids, with its head office in Hashima, Gifu Prefecture. The group consists of the company, two consolidated subsidiaries and two unconsolidated subsidiaries, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 247. The company is listed on the Main Market of the Nagoya Stock Exchange.
entries.7d4743f5832257b2: A company that publishes educational materials such as tests and drills for elementary and junior high schools, and manufactures and sells teaching aids such as sewing kits.
entries.8199280271489eba: This is the reporting segment that manufactures and sells teaching aids used by elementary and junior high school students, such as sewing kits and home economics cloth materials. The company manufactures and sells these products, and it has outsourced part of the manufacturing and shipping to consolidated subsidiary Robin Kikaku Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,753 million.
entries.d1a877c70b516d9b: This is the reporting segment that manufactures and sells test and drill publications and similar materials used by elementary and junior high school students. The company manufactures and sells elementary school educational books and general-interest books, and consolidated subsidiary Gakuhosha Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells junior high school educational books. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,385 million.
